slides.title: Type ; and pick the snippet you need
slides.text: Your snippets appear right under the caret, most used first. Keep typing to filter; Tab or Enter inserts.

slides.title: Type ;sig, get your signature
slides.text: Snippets expand the moment you finish the abbreviation, in inputs, text areas and rich editors on any site.

slides.title: Fill-in fields and dropdowns
slides.text: Ask for a name, pick a day: a small form opens next to the caret before the text goes in.

slides.title: See what you use most
slides.text: Every insert is counted, locally. Sort by most used, A–Z or recent.

slides.title: Private by design
slides.text: No account, no server, no analytics. Snippets and usage counts stay in your browser. Light and dark.
